# Minimum Draft Angle

Minimum inclination of faces relative to the pull direction.

<figure markdown="span">
![Minimum Draft Angle: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-draft-angle-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Minimum Draft Angle: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-draft-angle-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Inclination of faces relative to the pull direction.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Critical |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Critical** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 1.0° | 0.5° | Not yet sourced |
| PLA | 2.0° | 1.0° | Not yet sourced |
| PA | 1.0° | 0.0° | Not yet sourced |
| PC | 2.0° | 1.5° | Not yet sourced |
| PE | 1.5° | 0.5° | Not yet sourced |
| PP | 2.0° | 1.0° | Not yet sourced |
| PVC | 1.5° | 0.5° | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PET / PBT, PSU, PS, PUR.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Insufficient Draft (`{measured}`): This angle is below the recommended `{target}`. While tilted correctly, it is too shallow to guarantee a clean release. Increasing the angle reduces the risk of part deformation or drag marks.
!!! failure "Error"

    Critical Draft Violation (`{measured}`): A vertical or reverse taper will cause the part to grip the mold as it shrinks. Attempting to eject will likely scratch the surface or physically trap the part in the cavity.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
